tools.name: get_current_promo
tools.description: Get the currently active Upcomers promo/discount code (null when none).

tools.name: list_challenges
tools.description: List Upcomers trading challenges: phases, models (classic/turbo/legacy) and USD list prices per account size. Full rules: https://upcomers.com/index.md or the MCP server at https://upcomers.com/mcp.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Open the Upcomers checkout prefilled with a product. Args: productId (numeric id from /api/product-groups), platform (mt5|tradelocker|matchtrader|ctrader|dxtrade|markets), variant (CLASSIC|TURBO|LEGACY), code (promo). A human completes payment.
